dog.description_text: My foster writes: Mouse is such a curious little fellow. Despite his history and lack of socialization, he consistently shows signs of wanting to get closer to me. He often assigns himself the role of bathroom-guard and makes sure I am never alone when I'm in there. He loves to explore and is always seeking to discover his newest, comfiest hangout spot. Mouse is always showing his playful and lively side when he gets his daily zoomies, but he is also very content to just lay beside you while you're working at your desk. He loves to accompany you to the kitchen just in case you might have any treats to share. I see him at his most content when he lays next to my screened-in window, simply enjoying the fresh air and watching the bugs and birds. If you want a professional fly swatter, Mouse is the man for your job. Sometimes I forget that he's not just a baby because he always exhibits such youthful and curious behavior. Getting to know this guy is such a rewarding process.
dog.name: Dr. Mouse
